intro: Lesson 29. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ (٣٤) أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ مُّكْرَمُونَ (٣٥) فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ (٣٦) عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ (٣٧) أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ (٣٨) كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ (٣٩)

فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ (٤٠) عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ (٤١) فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ (٤٢) يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ (٤٣) خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ (٤٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer: They will be in gardens, honored.
So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad], [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure? No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised - The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ma'arij 70:34-44 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 70:34-44 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 70:34-44 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite all of Al-Ma'arij to a partner.
What does 70:40 swear by, and what does it promise?
questions.a: By the Lord of the risings and settings; that Allah is able to replace them with better.
A) In gardens, honoured. 70:35: 'They will be in gardens, honored.'

questions.q: Think again: The surah ends with people coming out of their graves 'as if racing to a goal' (70:43). What will you be racing towards?
questions.a: Allah's pleasure and Paradise: so we race in good deeds now.
